{{BossList|Default|Ref = Only the first '''Null Warden''' spawned in [[Outpost 16]] as a boss.}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Warden''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Warden''', was a tanky enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a high amount of health, higher than every enemy except the [[Null Commander]], and a decently fast speed. In the Hard difficulty of [[Outpost 16]], it always spawned with [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]], meaning towers needed lead detection to be able to damage it. ==Logbook Description== "''As the Null Warden crawled from the rift, the original tightened his gear and flicked out his baton. Warden glared at it from behind his visor. "Man you are ugly." he muttered. The Null Warden ran forward, slowed by the gear it wore. Warden planted his feet and raised his shield. "I don't know if I should feel insulted."''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Warden''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Warden]]. It has purple skin. It wears purple clothes, black vest, black helmet with a visor, knee-pads and gloves. What appears to be purple goo can be seen all over its body. A few pink spores can also be seen on it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Accelerator]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended here. **While not an issue in Easy difficulty, it is recommended that the towers brought in have lead detection, as in the Hard difficulty it always spawn as a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy. *There are a few ways to give towers lead detection in case none of the towers brought in have it. **The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give all towers lead detection at the start of the wave. **[[The Sun]] can be used to give every tower all detections, though it comes with the downside of making every enemy immune to stuns, freeze and burn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullWarden1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullWarden2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullWarden3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Warden''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullWardenIconIG.png|'''Null Warden''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Warden''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Warden''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Warden''' has a broken icon. *''' 19 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0|v1.77.3a]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Now appears in [[Banlands]]. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Warden''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Warden''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{Outpost16|[[Null Beast]]|Wave 13|Null Warden|Wave 15|[[Null Pyromancer]]|Wave 17}} {{Banlands|[[Null Electroshocker]] & [[Null Beast]]|Wave 17|Null Warden|Wave 18|[[Null Pyromancer]]|Wave 20}} {{BlindFaith|[[Null Pyromancer]]|Wave 11|Null Warden|Wave 13|[[Null Pursuit]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
